Interface CustomBlockManager

public interface CustomBlockManager
Represents a way to manage all CustomBlocks currently placed and loaded

    • move

      boolean move(org.bukkit.Location from, org.bukkit.Location to)
      Tries to move a block from a specified position to another. This should never throw but will return false if the to location is occupied or no block is present at the from location.
      Parameters:
      from - from location
      to - to location
      Returns:
      if the block was moved

    • move

      boolean move(org.bukkit.Location from, org.bukkit.Location to, boolean virtual)
      See move(Location, Location).
      Tries to move a block from a specified position to another. This should never throw but will return false if the to location is occupied or no block is present at the from location.
      If moved virtually, the physical block will be left untouched. This is useful when moving a block that is physically being moved otherwise (e.g. a piston pushing).
      Parameters:
      from - from location
      to - to location
      virtual - if the physical block should be left untouched
      Returns:
      if the block was moved
